_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime: 30d momentum flat, F&G inside 32-38, no PROVEN library hit, and 7-day base rate shows ±2pt score moves in only 3% of windows — HOLD is the graded call until a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Denial; analyst explicit HOLD high-conviction, narrative silent/awaiting so defers to analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed and phase score remain 32-38, 30d momentum near flat, no PROVEN macro pattern fires
next_move.invalidated_if: Fast sell pushes fear_greed/score below 32 into Panic, or ETF/fed_liquidity lift drives score above 39 into Anxiety
